beats.text: Why are leading AI teams switching to BERT after this 80.5% benchmark result?
beats.visual_focus: A linear text stream being scanned in only one direction.

beats.text: This directional bias is a architectural cage, forcing the model to guess dependencies without seeing the full sentence's structural intent.
beats.visual_focus: A rigid geometric barrier locking tokens into a single sequence.

beats.text: Enter BERT, which shatters the mask and uses deep bidirectional transformers to condition on context from both directions simultaneously.
beats.visual_focus: Two arrows merging inward onto a central token.
